import polars as pl


def transform(raw: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    # Split "Last, First" into "First Last"
    name_parts = raw.get_column("Employee Name").str.splitn(", ", 2)
    last_name = name_parts.struct.field("field_0")
    first_name = name_parts.struct.field("field_1")
    full_name = pl.when(first_name.is_not_null() & last_name.is_not_null()).then(
        first_name + " " + last_name
    ).otherwise(raw.get_column("Employee Name"))

    return raw.select(
        employee_id=pl.col("Employee ID").str.to_uppercase(),
        employee_name=full_name,
        work_date=pl.col("Date").str.to_date("%Y-%m-%d", strict=False),
        project_code=pl.col("Project").str.to_uppercase(),
        hours_normal=pl.col("Hours Normal").cast(pl.Float64, strict=False).round(2),
        hours_overtime=pl.col("Hours Overtime").cast(pl.Float64, strict=False).round(2),
    )
